purpose: The frame of every blind attempt of a cell (Codex Gate 2, P1.2): the same frame for the first attempt and for each retry, so that a rejection never changes the moment, the actor or the situation. attempt_frames.v1.json (frames A, B and C) is kept only as the record of the earlier design; it is not used.

frames.A: Choose the actor and the moment of the situation freely within the cell.
